subject: prd/tech-design-brainstorm
statement: When the frontier is empty, the skill shall put the gate to the authority and end only by recording their explicit verdict — ready-for-design, needs-more-product, needs-investigation, covered, or abandoned — with date and authority; a covered verdict shall name its covering design; a ready-for-design verdict shall embed the coverage-check result against the design-template's decision-shaped inputs.
rationale: the five-verdict enum is the ruling (#D-5); an unconfirmed direction is an assumed one
fit_criterion: 100% of ended fixture sessions carry exactly one gate entry with the verdict-conditional fields
